notes.title: MITS IS FREE!
notes.notes: In a few weeks, MITS will have an update with some gameplay updates, bug fixes and will become free on Steam! More updates soon!

notes.title: The Future of MITS
notes.notes:
I would like to show you in a simple format the future of MITS! The planning, development, and many behind the scene changes to benefit the MITS community! If you have any changes, ideas, features or bugs that you want to see attention to, please let us know, we are listening!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284908/1a8ac77a06ab90b1cf1981df5f6a0888892a81e4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UI Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] UI default state set to active
[*] Removed double jump glitch
[*] Added collision to some ghost objects
[*] Fixed save data system bug for new players
[/list]
Now new players will have defaulted UI visability settings to true. Concurrent players that have this issue will have to turn this settings manually to true in settings.
